prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1026; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, if that's okay. You can refer to me as the passenger.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?
A: I was riding in the front passenger seat of my friend's car. We were stopped at a traffic light on a main road in Conroe, Texas.
Q: What happened next?
A: We were sitting there for maybe thirty seconds when the car behind us hit us from the rear. It was a hard impact. Our car lurched forward and my head snapped back and then forward.
Q: Did you hit anything inside the vehicle?
A: No, I didn't hit the dashboard or the window. But my neck felt like it was yanked, and I felt it right away.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: Yes, the same day. An ambulance took me from the scene because I couldn't turn my head without pain. They checked me out and then I went to a clinic the next morning.
Q: What treatment have you received since then?
A: I've had physical therapy three times a week, and they gave me a soft collar to wear at night. I also take prescription anti-inflammatories, and I still get headaches most afternoons.
Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?
A: Not that I can recall. I had no ongoing treatment before this. I was healthy and active.
Q: Are you still working?
A: I've been out of work for a few weeks because sitting at a desk makes the pain worse. My doctor has given me restrictions on lifting and driving.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm still hoping to get back to normal. I'm grateful for the care I've received, and I'd like this claim handled fairly.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
